teaser: The PrompTugal.news team wants to continue. A roadmap: outreach by agentic teams, local partners, a subscribe box, a verification layer, twelve cards.
core_idea: PrompTugal.news has the material; the next phase is people, through agent-drafted, person-sent outreach, subscriptions and a verification layer that records who checked each story.

quotes.text: The worst thing we could do with that energy is leave it without specific things to do.
An agent never sends an email or posts.
The outreach and the verification are the same work.

figures.caption: Twelve task cards for the PrompTugal.news team: pick one, point your agentic team at it, report back.
The outreach machine: publish, find the public contact, draft, a person sends, replies on a lane, follow up.
A verification layer: sourced, model-checked, read and signed, source-confirmed, certified.
